newsitem.title: MEXICO: ICA may start Malaysia dam in December.
newsitem.headline: ICA may start Malaysia dam in December.

text.p: Mexican construction giant Empresas ICA expects to start work in December on a massive dam and hydrelectric project in Bakun, Malaysia, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
"Between this week and next, more or less, the construction contract will be signed, and at the end of December work on the public works project will begin," spokesman Alejandro Marquez said.
He said ICA President Bernardo Quintana was in Malaysia and had already signed the concession contract.

ICA is building about 25 percent of the 2,500-megawatt dam for $225 million over the next five years in a partnership with one of the Hyundai Group companies of South Korea and the privately held CBPO of Brazil. The $1 billion dam is part of a larger $6 billion public works project in Malaysia. The project has been delayed because of environmental concerns there.
